method: Fresh independent body-by-body review of every inventory web/tests/** file, including fixture setup, complete test bodies, race interleavings, error/receipt recovery, mutation dispatch barriers, stale-owner isolation, draft retention, consent, media/terminal limits, and teardown. Read the complete implicated FileEditor, Api and file-draft implementations plus repository test/snapshot entrypoints. The current-round implementation reviewer supplied the FileEditor candidate; verified its source path independently and reproduced it with the real Api and real fake-indexeddb adapter, without mocking createOperation or delaying its implementation. No prior audits, reports, WORKLOG, Git history, or archived checkout were inspected. Body coverage is separate from execution coverage.

findings.title: Preserve edits made while durable save intent is being created
findings.body: save captures original before Api.beginMutation. Api awaits createOperation at web/lib/api.ts:424 before invoking prepare at :433. The editor remains editable during that wait, but prepare constructs next from original and replaces persistent draft, cache, current ref, and rendered draft. Text typed after clicking Save and before the IDB transaction completes is overwritten. The later readback sees the reverted revision as the submitted revision and clears the only stored draft, so the newer text is lost. The existing workspace-ui pending-save test waits until the fetch handler is installed before editing, leaving this reachable pre-dispatch interval untested.
findings.repro: Run fixedNode .work/round17-web-tests-repro.mjs. The isolated test uses current FileEditor, actual Api, repository operation-setup and fake-indexeddb; click Save with sent-v1, assert fetch has not started and textarea is enabled, type newer-v2, then await dispatch and successful readback. Immediately after the durable commit both textarea and stored draft revert to sent-v1; after readback cacheSize is 0 and the stored draft is absent. Expected newer-v2 assertion fails. No artificial IDB delay is introduced.
findings.suggestedChange: Attach pending metadata to the latest draft while retaining the submitted revision/text from original, or prevent edits for the entire admission interval. Add a real-Api regression that edits before dispatch, including readback completion.

findings.title: Wait for durable mutation dispatch before using test response callbacks
findings.body: The draft pending-send test calls finish immediately after Api.mutate, although Api now awaits IndexedDB admission before invoking fetch. finish is therefore unset and the test fails with TypeError, leaving a pending mutation past teardown. process-remote.test.tsx has the same outdated scheduling assumption: pairingFixture.create at :565-566 uses an empty async act as a completion barrier, then inspects code-0 before pairing/start has dispatched; several process tests also assert post-mutation state before durable completion. These tests fail before exercising their intended race/ownership behavior.
findings.repro: Run fixedNode scripts/run-tests.mjs --targeted web/tests/drafts.test.tsx: 10 passed, 1 failed at finish line178. Run fixedNode scripts/run-tests.mjs --targeted web/tests/preview-server.test.ts web/tests/process-remote.test.tsx: process-remote has 15 passed, 29 failed; pairing tests repeatedly fail in fixture.create at line566. Both runs use isolatedTestEnvironment through the repository runner. The draft teardown also produces a late relative /api/rpc URL parse error after the fetch stub is removed; no external request is made.
findings.suggestedChange: Wait for an observable dispatch or completed state rather than assuming synchronous admission or using an empty act. Under fake timers allow the IndexedDB event loop to progress, and settle pending operations before restoring global stubs.

findings.title: Advertise the current operation recovery protocol in the preview session fixture
findings.body: The visual fixture session returns authenticated and csrf but omits operationRecoveryProtocol:2. Its ready helper explicitly requires that field, so 13 of the 15 preview-server tests fail before reaching their actual HTTP/WebSocket/error-path assertions. Api.session also consumes this protocol to initialize the operation journal, so the fixture no longer represents the current browser session contract.
findings.repro: The isolated two-file targeted run recorded in run-PzlrEa fails 13 preview-server tests at web/tests/preview-server.test.ts:29, with operationRecoveryProtocol:2 missing from the actual response. The server is local 127.0.0.1 only.
findings.suggestedChange: Return operationRecoveryProtocol:2 from the fixture session endpoint so the existing contract assertion and downstream route tests execute.

targetedExecutions.purpose: Independent real-Api reproduction of the pre-dispatch FileEditor edit-loss race

runtime.environment: scripts/test-environment.mjs isolatedTestEnvironment; existing repository dependencies; jsdom/fake-indexeddb and stubbed fetch, with loopback-only preview fixture tests

executionLimitations: No full suite was run; only the explicitly listed focused reproduction and targeted files were executed.
No real credentials, paid APIs, external network services, remote 120 machine, production runtime, or native browser/media/PTY integration was used.
No source or committed tests were changed; reproduction helpers and outputs were written only under ignored .work.
